input.jobDescription:
Data Scientist at AnalyticsFirm

AnalyticsFirm helps Fortune 500 companies make better decisions with data. We're hiring a Data Scientist to build predictive models and data pipelines.

What you'll do:
- Develop and deploy machine learning models for customer churn and demand forecasting
- Perform exploratory data analysis and feature engineering
- Build data pipelines with Apache Spark or dbt
- Present findings to non-technical stakeholders

Required:
- Python (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn)
- SQL (complex queries, window functions)
- Statistical modeling and hypothesis testing
- Data visualization (matplotlib, seaborn, or Tableau)
- Jupyter notebooks

Bonus:
- Experience with A/B testing at scale
- MLflow or similar experiment tracking
- Cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery)

Full-time in Chicago or remote. Send resume to data-jobs@analyticsfirm.com
